tasks.title: Pick a base and graft
tasks.detail: Write 3-6 gradeable criteria for {{args}}, then read every candidate end to end and score each. Pick the base a maintainer can extend most easily, graft the few worthwhile parts of the others by hand, and verify the result. Report the base and why, each graft and its source, and the verification output.
